incidents.name: ElevateFi
incidents.notes: ElevateFi getPriceUSD read raw DAI/EFI pair reserves, so the attacker pumped the pair spot price to create underpriced package-7 stakes and claim inflated EFI rewards.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0xcddc83a34fc9a7b9e6b1df7c14b585cf73283174 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x816ec92012e61269dcfe72188fe6d2352defce74, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (6314s -> 6107s)
